articles.title: Anti-trafficking group says Clarity Act's Section 604 could weaken accountability
articles.snippet: An anti-human trafficking advocate said a Clarity Act provision could weaken accountability despite existing criminal laws.

articles.title: Bitcoin bounces from $58,000 as derivatives signal more pain in the pipeline
articles.snippet: BTC touched its lowest level since September 2024 before rebounding to $59,770, while ETH slipped further and another $1 billion in futures positions were wiped out.

articles.title: Grant Cardone says he will keep buying bitcoin using real estate cash flows
articles.snippet: The real estate investor pitched his model as a treasury company backed by cash-flowing property rather than stock sales, framing the slide in bitcoin as a chance to accumulate.

articles.title: Kraken in talks to buy 15% stake in DeFi lender Aave at $385 million valuation
articles.snippet: The DeFi lender is rebuilding after the fallout from April's KelpDAO exploit sparked a multibillion-dollar exodus of deposits despite Aave itself not being hacked.

articles.title: BlackBerry is making a massive comeback as an 'uncrashable' software layer for AI and robotics
articles.snippet: BlackBerry's stock is surging after the company's massive earnings beat and is pivoting into becoming a critical component of the AI and robotics boom.
